title: Governed records live in git, not only on this Mac
description: Found while cleaning up on 2026-10-20. runtime-data/ is git-ignored, yet it holds governed records: the Day-0 certification, educational corpus and its certification, initial competency evidence, certification and human acceptance, production workspace authorization, authority resolutions, and the conversation expected history with its amendments, candidate review, coverage and completeness certifications (about 1 MB). They exist only on the owner's Mac. The activation record itself is already tracked (KO-5c), but its prerequisites are not, so losing this disk would suspend the Chief Agent (ADR-0041: unreadable governance suspends). The rest of runtime-data is rebuildable cache (Genesis replays and historical correlation, about 690 MB) or private source material (recovered ChatGPT conversations, about 7 MB).
objective: A fresh clone, with no runtime-data, has every certification and authorization the Chief Agent's activation depends on, and the activation gate reads ACTIVE without re-certifying.
risks: Moving a record the activation gate reads can suspend the Chief Agent; the move must be proven with the gate ACTIVE before and after.
Private conversation content must not reach GitHub: the educational corpus and conversation records are checked for raw conversation text before anything is tracked.
Records are moved once; Runtime must not keep two copies that can drift.
